page_title: SAS 2-2 SAL | Sassuolo v Salernitana 10/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+2' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
90+2' Good clearance! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
90+1' The foul by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) was seen by Davide Ghersini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Guillermo Ochoa (Salernitana) leaps to collect the ball.
89' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

86' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Guillermo Ochoa pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left-hand post.

86' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
85' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Giulio Maggiore walks off the pitch to be replaced by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana).
83' The game is interrupted as Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is flagged offside.
82' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) gets inside the box and tries to beat Guillermo Ochoa with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
80' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
79' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
79' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
77' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is caught offside!
75' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) is adjudged offside.
74' Chance! Simy (Salernitana) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
72' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) replacing Gregoire Defrel.
72' Substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replaces Samu Castillejo.
71' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
70' Simy (Salernitana) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
70' The ball is out of play. Salernitana will have a throw-in.
66' Simy (Salernitana) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
64' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillermo Ochoa intercepts the ball.
63' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
61' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Ghersini no option but to blow his whistle.
60' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) replaces Emil Bohinen.
60' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
59' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
58' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
56' Substitution. Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi will be replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
56' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to substitute Loum Tchaouna and he is replaced by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana).
54' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

52' 2 - 2 Goal! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) takes a short pass from Matias Vina in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 2:2.
51' Unlucky! A great strike from Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
49' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
48' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
48' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
47' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
46' We are about to witness a substitution. Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is replacing Flavius Daniliuc.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Davide Ghersini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Close! Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The foul by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Ghersini.
43' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
43' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' The resulting corner from Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) comes to nothing.
41' Handball! A player from Sassuolo handled the ball.
39' OFF THE POST! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
38' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
36' 1 - 2 Goal! Gregoire Defrel plays a pass to the feet of Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:2.
34' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
34' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
33' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
31' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) plays a through ball but overhits it.
29' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
27' Dangerous play by Matias Vina (Sassuolo). Davide Ghersini blows his whistle for a foul.
23' The resulting corner from Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
23' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Sassuolo will take a corner kick.
23' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Ghersini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' 0 - 2 Goal! Loum Tchaouna tees up Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the top right corner. 0:2.
16' The ball is behind the touchline and Salernitana will take a throw-in.
15' Davide Ghersini blows his whistle as Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
12' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
10' Great save! Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Guillermo Ochoa.
8' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
3' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo. It will be a corner kick for Sassuolo.
2' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Salernitana will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Davide Ghersini.
